name: Carbon-Based Technology Inc.
summary: Carbon-Based Technology, Inc. specializes in the innovation, engineering, and production of advanced composite materials, as well as comprehensive systems and airframes for unmanned aerial vehicles. Its cutting-edge solutions are widely adopted across various sectors, including defense and commercial drone applications, electric vehicle manufacturing, composite structure repair, and the creation of bespoke carbon fiber components. The firm, which was established in 1996, operates from its headquarters located in Taipei City, Taiwan.
